crossRefs.note: Then all the children of Israel went out, and the congregation was assembled as one man, from Dan even to Beersheba…
to transfer the kingdom from Saul’s house, and to set up David’s throne over Israel and over Judah, from Dan even to…
But I counsel that all Israel be gathered together to you, from Dan even to Beersheba, as the sand that is by the sea…
I thank him who enabled me, Christ Jesus our Lord, because he counted me faithful, appointing me to service;

people.name: Beersheba
people.line: Important city in southern Israel, associated with the patriarchs.

people.name: Dan
people.line: Israelite tribe; city in northern Israel; originally called Laish/Leshem.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Samuel
people.line: Prophet and last judge of Israel before the kings

translations.web: All Israel from Dan even to Beersheba knew that Samuel was established to be a prophet of Yahweh.
translations.bsb: So all Israel from Dan to Beersheba knew that Samuel was confirmed as a prophet of the LORD.
translations.kjv: And all Israel from Dan even to Beersheba knew that Samuel was established to be a prophet of the LORD.
translations.asv: And all Israel from Dan even to Beer-sheba knew that Samuel was established to be a prophet of Jehovah.
